messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-413 — PROD alert: runtime-engine pods in gpu-pool-a are crashlooping (SIGSEGV). 30/40 pods failing. First seen 2024-05-14T11:00:01Z.

Eva: seeing a bunch of 500s and OOM-looking traces in logs but primary is segfault. paging oncall. customer impact: increased error rate on text-gen routes.

Kevin: I'm on call. Confirming: node-17 and node-19 showing repeated container restarts. Crash reason in container logs: `segfault (0x1) at ip 0x7f2c9d4b3f` in `libengine.so` — looks like runtime/engine native crash, possibly fused kernel path.

Chris: added some logs from one pod (truncated):
```
[2024-05-14T10:59:58Z] runtime: vLLM worker init model=redwood-13b, device=0
[2024-05-14T11:00:00Z] libengine.so+0x1a3f4: fused_attn_kernel_launch()
[2024-05-14T11:00:00Z] *** SIGSEGV ***
backtrace: 0x7f2c9d4b3f libengine.so, 0x55a8c1...
```
Chris: also saw `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in nvml logs on node-17 shortly before segfaults.

Maria: stack suggests fused-kernel code path — a good candidate is recent TRT fused kernel optimization we shipped in canary last week for 13B. Any recent rollouts?

Eva: we did a small canary of fused-kernel build `engine:canary-20240509` in gpu-pool-a (10% traffic) and scaled to 30% yesterday.

Kevin: immediate plan: cordon node-17/19, drain if safe, scale down runtime-worker replicas in that pool to reduce blast radius, and flip runtime env to disable fused kernels. I'll take lead.

infra-bot: Executing: `kubectl cordon node-17` — OK.
infra-bot: Executing: `kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — ok, evicted pods.

Kevin: running `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-worker DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 -n prod` to force software fallback path (non-fused TF/TRT). Then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-worker -n prod`.

Chris: while that rolls, recommend scaling down canary: `kubectl scale deploy runtime-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`.

Maria: also capture core dump from one failing container before it disappears. run: `kubectl debug -it pod/<crashpod> --image=ubuntu:22.04 --target=container` and copy /var/crash/core.* to S3.

Eva: CS reporting ~6 customers saw elevated latencies and 500s; broad impact: roughly 4% of text-gen calls failed between 10:59–11:05 UTC. Not a full outage but customer-facing.

customer-success: Escalating to customers: paused noisy retries for affected routes, communicated we are mitigating and will follow up with ETA.

Kevin: hotpatch steps done: DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL env set, canary scaled down, runtime-worker rolled. Watching.

infra-bot: rollout status: 18/40 pods updated, 12 still terminating, 10 running on fallback path.

Chris: quick telemetry check — error rate dropping from 4% -> 0.8% over last 2 minutes. Good sign.

Kevin: captured gdb backtrace from core: `#0 0x00007f2c9d4b3f in fused_attn_kernel_launch() from /opt/runtime/libengine.so` then `#1 0x55a8c1... in runtime_dispatch`. Suspect unsafe pointer in fused path.

Maria: on ML side, we'll revert or disable fused kernel in next builds and run extended CI on RTX A6000 matrix. Also add a guard to avoid illegal addresses on large seq lengths.

Eva: are we seeing node-level GPU page faults? kernel logs had `nvidia 0000:01:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus` on node-19 at 10:59:59. That could explain device state corruption.

Kevin: action items now: 1) Mark nodes cordoned until validated, 2) keep fused disabled cluster-wide, 3) gather cores + nvml logs + kernel dmesg, 4) open INC ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml. I'm going to hand off to Chris for next shift.

Kevin: handoff to @chris at 11:05 UTC — I'm stepping off pager.

Chris: ack taking over. Will coordinate with runtime eng for a targeted hotfix and prepare rollback of engine:canary-20240509 in registry and block further canaries.

infra-bot: Nodes cordoned: node-17, node-19, node-21. Pod counts: 12 failing pods evicted.

Chris: customer impact update for CS: error rate stabilized ~0.5%, latency normalizing. Recommend sending update to affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for full postmortem.

customer-success: Sending update now.

Maria: logging ticket: ENG-RT-713 — reproduce on headless repro harness with sequence length 4096 and batch size 4; initial runs show illegal address in fused kernel. I'll link stack dumps.

Chris: follow-up: disable canary gate for fused kernels by default until validation passes, add automated guard in runtime to detect illegal device memory and fallback to unfused path without process crash.

Eva: will schedule postmortem and blameless RCA. Please save all cores, nvml logs, and the env/version of each affected pod.

chris: closing immediate pager — mitigation successful for now, but incident remains open until patches and full verification. I'll keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
